description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_status_page plan, including publishing it. Returns the new page's public address and what it shows. The page is public as soon as it is created. Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result and never a second page. Not for changing an existing page: use update_status_page.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.

name: create_status_page
title: Create the planned status page
